description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.desc: Dolphins rookie Kyle Louis' 21-day practice window will open on Wednesday.
items.impact: Louis has been on injured reserve with an MCL sprain. His status for Sunday's game against the Jets remains up in the air.
items.title: Kyle Louis (knee) to have practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu will remain sidelined from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nwangwu remains uncertain for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.title: Kene Nwangwu not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets LB Kiko Mauigoa is considered week-to-week.
items.impact: Mauigoa is likely to remain sidelined on Sunday against the Dolphins.
items.title: Kiko Mauigoa (leg) week-to-week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets DL Joseph Ossai is considered week-to-week.
items.impact: Ossai is likely to remain sidelined on Sunday against the Dolphins.
items.title: Joseph Ossai (ankle) week-to-week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dylan Parham will practice on a limited basis on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parham has been sidelined for the past three games. He'll have a chance to return on Sunday against the Dolphins.
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said he thinks there's pretty good chance DT Mason Graham will be able to play on Sunday against the Titans.
items.impact: Monken notes that Graham was frustrated he wasn't cleared to play last week. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) could return Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said he's optimistic Dylan Sampson will be able to play on Sunday against the Titans.
items.impact: Sampson has been on injured reserve since Week 1. He recently had his practice window opened.
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) optimistic for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said he's optimistic RB Quinshon Judkins will be able to play on Sunday against the Titans.
items.impact: Judkins was sidelined last week. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) optimistic for Week 7

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Falcons designated A.J. Terrell Jr. to return from injured reserve.
items.impact: Terrell will have his practice window opened. He'll have the next 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) designated to return by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Breece Hall will not return to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Glenn added that Hall will be evaluated as the week goes on. He is currently unlikely to return this week, leaving Braelon Allen in line for another start.
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) will not practice Wednesday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy will be the Giants starter in their Week 7 matchup against Houston.
items.impact: The Giants have benched Jameis Winston in favor of the younger McCarthy, who came to the Giants via trade with Minnesota a couple weeks ago. McCarthy has his flaws, some of which were on full display in the Giants comeback attempt against the Saints. However, he also nearly brought them back to a win, so it sounds like the coaching staff has decided the benefits outweigh the risks. Expect Malik Nabers and Isaiah Likely to continue to be force fed targets, with smaller shares going to Malachi Fields, Darnell Mooney, and the like.
items.title: J.J. McCarthy starting for Giants in Week 7

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Adonai Mitchell will return to practice.
items.impact: Mitchell has been sidelined the past few weeks after undergoing a procedure on his finger. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) to return to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Atlanta Falcons have signed DE Charles Snowden to the active roster from Washington's practice squad.
items.impact: Snowden will add depth on the defensive line for Atlanta.
items.title: Charles Snowden signed by Falcons

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The NFL suspended Sam Franklin for one game.
items.impact: Franklin was seen spitting on a Raiders player late in the fourth quarter of the Bills' Week 6 win. The Bills on are bye this week.
items.title: Sam Franklin Jr. suspended one game

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans released DT Jordan Elliott.
items.impact: Elliott reportedly went to his car to retrieve his gun after a practice altercation with OT JC Latham last Thursday. He signed a two-year, $8 million deal this offseason.
items.title: Jordan Elliott released by Titans

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will not return to practice this week.
items.impact: After being selected with the eighth-overall pick in this year's draft, Tyson has yet to make his NFL debut due to a hamstring injury. The rookie is progressing,  but he is still not ready to get back on the practice field. Devaughn Vele and Chris Olave will continue to lead the Saints' WR corps.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will not practice this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson is not expected to be activated when first eligible next week.
items.impact: Ferguson will remain on injured reserve. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) not expected to be activated next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys signed Kyle Trask to their practice squad.
items.impact: Trask will step into the QB3 role for Dallas.
items.title: Kyle Trask signs with Cowboys
